rows.name: GET on a trigger is refused with 405
POST to a read-only path is refused with 405
Unknown path is 404 and self-describing
asserts: lists the paths that do exist

rows.name: Unknown recipe code is 404, not a silent success
A trailing slash on an unknown code is still 404
A trigger with NO token is refused with 401
asserts: leaks nothing about the expected value

rows.name: A trigger with a WRONG token is refused with 401, identically
asserts: same body as the no-token case
